findings.title: Normal atomic publication exposes a transient multi-link file and permanently consumes the single attempt
findings.actual: writePrivate linkSync(temp,path) makes file nlink2 until unlinkSync(temp). Independent owner may poll in between. readPrivate rejects nlink2 after attempted=true; writes REJECTED ACK with null request hash. Browser reports ACK_IDENTITY_MISMATCH and cannot retry even though real owning port was never called. ACK publication has same transient nlink2 risk on browser reader.
findings.deterministicReproduction: In a pure local Node fixture, patch node:fs.linkSync via syncBuiltinESMExports, call original link, then invoke owner.poll synchronously only when REQUEST destination is published, before writePrivate returns to unlink temp. Real fixture port returns RESERVED_LOCK_RETAINED if called. Callback throws BROWSER_ACK_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; owner result REJECTED; calls0; second poll undefined. Temporary files removed after fixture; no network/credentials.
findings.impact: Fail-closed safety preserved, but valid interprocess schedule irreversibly aborts only attempt. Current16 tests omit the link/unlink interleaving.
findings.minimalRequiredFix: Make publication completion and consumption compatible for both request and ACK. Preserve no-replacement/symlink/multilink/owner/mode security and one owning attempt. Do not weaken nlink validation or retry/refund owning reservation; add deterministic request and ACK publication-interleaving regressions. Exact protocol choice belongs implementation child.
